items.title: 13.9 Ghaliz sulfuric acid ke saath halides (X-) ke reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.9, printed page 299.

blocks.text: Mukhtalif halide ions concentrated sulfuric acid se mukhtalif tarah react karte hain. Group mein fluoride se iodide tak neeche jate hue product bhi badalta hai aur reaction ki qism bhi.
Concentrated sulfuric acid NaF se react kare to hydrogen fluoride gas ke dhuen (fumes) bante hain. HF kamzor reducing agent hai, is liye yeh H₂SO₄ se aage react nahi karta.
Concentrated sulfuric acid sodium chloride se react kare to hydrogen chloride gas ke dhuen bante hain.

Br⁻ ion ke saath hydrogen bromide (HBr) gas ke bhaap jaise (steamy) dhuen aur bromine (Br₂) ke bhoore dhuen bante hain, aur sulfur dioxide (SO₂) ki boo aati hai. Yeh redox reaction (jis mein ek cheez oxidize aur doosri reduce ho) hai. Hydrogen bromide reducing agent ka kaam karta hai: sulfuric acid ko sulfur dioxide mein reduce karta hai aur khud oxidize ho kar bromine ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne 2HBr(s) + H₂SO₄(l) → Br₂(g) + 2SO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) chhapa hai. Yeh balanced nahi: ek H₂SO₄ mein sirf ek S atom hai, is liye sirf ek SO₂ banta hai. Kitab ne HBr ko (s) yani solid bhi likha hai; yahan HBr gas (g) hai. Sahi equation oopar hai.

Concentrated sulfuric acid sodium iodide se react kare to hydrogen iodide gas ke dhuen, solid iodine (I₂) ke banafshi (purple) dhuen aur H₂S gas ki boo (sare hue anday jaisi) aati hai. HI taqatwar reducing agent hai: yeh H₂SO₄ ko H₂S mein reduce karta hai aur khud oxidize ho kar I₂ ban jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne HI ko 8HI(s) yani solid likha hai; yahan HI gas (g) hai. Baqi equation balanced aur sahi hai.
Fluoride se iodide tak halide ions (X⁻) ki reducing power barhti hai, isi liye concentrated sulfuric acid ke saath in ke reactions zyada pecheeda (complex) hote jate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: F⁻ aur Cl⁻ kamzor reducing agents hain, is liye sirf HF aur HCl bante hain. Br⁻ zyada taqatwar hai aur sulfur ko +6 se +4 (SO₂) tak le jata hai. I⁻ sab se taqatwar hai aur sulfur ko +6 se -2 (H₂S) tak le jata hai. Jitna taqatwar reducing agent, utna gehra reduction.

items: NaX + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HX: har halide pehle HX deta hai.
F⁻ aur Cl⁻ wahin ruk jate hain; Br⁻ aage Br₂ + SO₂ deta hai; I⁻ aage I₂ + H₂S deta hai.
Reducing power F⁻ se I⁻ tak barhti hai, is liye reactions zyada complex hote hain.
